'When you play this, if you have less {h} than an opposing hero, this gains +1{p}.'

Checked ONCE, when the attack goes on the chain -- 'when you play this, IF' is a trigger with a gate, not a continuous property. A WHILE_STATIC would re-check it on every power recalculation and take the bonus back the moment the life totals crossed back over mid-combat, which the printed text does not say.
